changes.details: Corrected false claims in Elevator Pitch (204→141 papers, 103/103→79/88 survived). Replaced 4 LCDM-stub inference modules with DOI-published chi2 values. Added automated cross-validation gate that blocks publishing on data inconsistencies. Added α-signal transparency panel showing both LOO (2.2σ) and MCMC (0.7σ) results. Expanded maintain pipeline to 10 steps with Symbiose council integration.

Extended Kill-Test v6 probe-2 methodology to all 175 SPARC galaxies with identical scipy.differential_evolution pipeline (seed=42, AIC model comparison). Single-component EFC wins 60.2% on 171/175 fitted galaxies (42.1% EFC_decisive). Median ΔAIC = +6.21. Mann-Whitney FLOW vs LATENT p ≈ 0. Spearman ρ(ΔAIC, v_max) = 0.11 (no mass bias). DDO 154 anchor cross-check: ΔAIC = +125.2. Cherry-picking objection against probe-2 refuted; universality verdict CONFIRMED at single-component level. See docs/papers/efc/Kill-Test v6 Universality_SPARC175/. DOI 10.6084/m9.figshare.31986762.
